g.text: Same Main30 binary: accepted ordinary reference and PQ operating points
Ordinary: Alpenglow development genesis/BLS voting, Ed25519 TXs. Rates are configured targets; PQ admission is backpressured.
First two bars: matched target, different duration. Hatched bars: other targets. Offer-window resources; drain-inclusive TPS.
